title: Infernal Iron
summary: Give Infernal Iron to Dammon for Karlach’s engine upgrades or Flawed Helldusk equipment.

fields.Karlach: Use one at the Druid Grove for Heart of Iron and another at Last Light Inn for Heart Ablaze, which replaces it.
fields.Crafting: At Last Light Inn, Dammon can forge Flawed Helldusk Armour, Helmet, and Gloves in order.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
